zh: 与基座 Web 版双向对齐：AI BI 看板、标记与样式以 Web 版为准同步；AI 报表查询与运行日志合并两边改进（百分比不再重复放大、日志保留模型与用量信息、可中途取消生成）；技能中心可直接上传技能包，会话列表支持查看已归档；修复技能卡片样式里一段残留代码导致精选卡片高度失效、工作空间栏为空时留白、换语言后工具卡片徽标消失、英文界面显示中文默认简介。
en: Two-way alignment with the web edition: the AI BI board, markers and styles now follow the web edition; AI report queries and run logs merge improvements from both sides (no double percentage scaling, logs keep model and usage details, generation can be cancelled); skills can be uploaded from the Skill Hub and archived conversations can be viewed; fixed a stray stylesheet fragment that broke featured card height, an empty workspace bar leaving a gap, tool card badges disappearing after switching language, and Chinese default descriptions shown in English.
